I created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ClassUtilsAgentTest.java` with 88 tests covering `ClassUtils`, including boundary/error cases (invalid array dimensions, oversized class names, `getClassStrict` vs `getClass` whitespace normalization, primitive widening edge cases, interface/superclass hierarchy traversal order, null handling for every public method, etc.).

All 88 tests pass — I did not find any bugs in `ClassUtils` worth flagging. The one deprecation note is expected (the test exercises the deprecated public no-arg constructor, as the class's own Javadoc directs callers to do via reflection-based tooling).
